import numpy as np
# Fit dP = P*(a0+a1 t + a2 t^2 + a3 sin t + a4 cos t) + P^2*(b) etc. check
def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-A@c
    print(names, np.round(c,4), np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
    return r
